summary: Regression run after the Phase 1 security hardening. BACKEND: new self-cleaning pytest file test_launch_hardening.py, 12/12 passing. Covered: the full E2E path with demo accounts (book, job shows in /jobs, accept, pickup checklist to picked_up, a text file sent as image/png is rejected with 422, a real PNG upload returns 201, delivered with the returned evidence_url, a second delivered returns 400, exactly 1 commission ledger row, confirm_token stored). Also: a finalized job is immutable (admin PUT 403) and can't be deleted (400). Download tokens: 5-min token, rejected as a session token (401), work on evidence/billing export/custody PDF/driver-doc file; a session JWT in ?auth= gets 401 and the Bearer header still works. Reviews: no token 400/403, wrong token 403, correct token 200. Job rules: driver PUT 403; facility payout/dropoff change after accept 403; delete of an accepted job 400, open job 200 and gone from the DB. Complete: driver 403, admin with no reason 422, admin with reason 200 (completed, 1 commission), a second complete 400. Dispatcher: open->offered with a driver, picked_up/delivered 400, offered->open, open->cancelled, accepted->cancelled. Concurrent accept: 7 races, always exactly one 200 and the loser gets 400 or 409. Auth: short password 422, mixed-case duplicate 400, case-insensitive login, suspended user (DB status + token_version bump) gets 401 on /me and 403 on login. Facility: create forces pending even with status=approved, and booking against it is 403. Twilio webhook unsigned or bogus signature 403. FRONTEND (Playwright 1920x1080): the driver UI E2E worked (accept on the board, /delivery/{id}, seal checks, checklist, transit, arrived, signature canvas, Mark Delivered, Delivered summary). Copy tip link puts ?t=<confirm_token> in the clipboard. The EarningsPage custody-evidence-image loads (naturalWidth 640, auth= in the src) and so does the FacilityHomePage pod-evidence-image. Facility CSV/PDF exports, admin custody PDF and the 4 admin revenue exports all call window.open with ?auth=<download token>; those URLs return 200 with the right content type. RatePage without ?t= shows the 'review link is invalid' toast; with ?t= the success card shows. No 4xx/5xx and no page errors in these flows.

critical.issue: confirm_token is in DRIVER_JOB_FIELDS, so the assigned driver gets the recipient's review/confirm token (needed for the ?t= tip link). The driver can POST /api/reviews/{job_id} with their own token and leave themselves a 5-star review, and can also call POST /api/public/confirm/{token} as if they were the recipient. The confirm_token gate does not stop the driver, who is the main party with a reason to fake reviews. Fix: use a separate tip-only token for the driver link (e.g. tip_token, accepted by the tip endpoint only), keep confirm_token out of driver responses, and require confirm_token (or a separate review_token sent only to the recipient by SMS) for reviews and confirmation.

minor.issue: The custody event is inserted before settle_job_completion's atomic flip. Two concurrent 'delivered' posts can both pass the status pre-check: the second inserts a second 'delivered' custody event and then gets 409 from the settle step. That leaves a stray delivered event in the append-only chain. Do the atomic status flip before inserting the event, or a conditional pre-claim.
Under a real race the loser usually gets 400 'Job is no longer available' from the non-atomic pre-read, and only sometimes 409. That is safe (never two winners), but the clients see different codes.

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' (os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*')) and the response shows access-control-allow-origin: *. Auth is a Bearer token in localStorage, not an httpOnly cookie. This was already the case and is acceptable with Bearer auth, but production should set explicit origins and drop the default.
By design, cancelled jobs can no longer be deleted (400), so test or junk cancelled jobs can't be removed through the API. Consider an admin archive/purge path for jobs that never had custody events.

ui_bugs.component: EarningsPage custody timeline (likely also the Facility / Dispatch timelines)
ui_bugs.issue: EVENT_META has no entries for 'seal_verified' or 'seal_exception', so a successful seal check falls back to the red 'Exception' label and icon. Drivers see 2 'Exception' rows on a perfectly clean delivery.

integration_issues.issue: window.open is called after an await of the download-token request, so it is outside the click's user gesture. Safari/iOS and strict popup blockers may block the export or PDF tab. Fix: open a blank window synchronously, then set its location after the token arrives, or prefetch the token like FacilityHomePage does with dlToken.

action_items: HIGH: Stop exposing confirm_token to drivers. Issue a separate tip-only token for copyTipLink, and gate reviews and public confirm on a token only the recipient gets.
Add seal_verified and seal_exception to EVENT_META in EarningsPage, and in every other custody timeline component.
Optional: in the 'delivered' custody event, do the atomic status claim before inserting the custody event.
Optional: make openSecureUrl popup-blocker-safe (open the window synchronously, then set its location).
Optional: set an explicit CORS_ORIGINS for production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4,762 lines and should be split into routers (auth, jobs, custody, facility, admin, billing).
DRIVER_JOB_FIELDS includes confirm_token, which undermines the review/confirm gating (see HIGH issue).
create_custody_event: insert-then-settle order can leave orphan 'delivered' events under concurrency.
FacilityCreate has no contact_email field, although the review request says it is required. Extra fields are silently ignored.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 pytest; 1 HIGH design-level security gap found by probe)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested flows work (1 MEDIUM label bug)

The disposable test_hard_* user and the TEST_Pending Clinic facility were deleted by id. The UI-created review on job aa0d1e17 and the API-created review were deleted. demo.driver total_trips went up by 2 and driver1/demo.driver got commission ledger rows for the TEST jobs.

rca of the issue: Driver self-review: the tip-link feature added confirm_token to DRIVER_JOB_FIELDS so JobsPage.copyTipLink could append ?t=. The same token is the only secret checked by submit_review and public_confirm_delivery, so the driver holds the recipient's credential. Reproduction: as demo.driver, GET /api/jobs/{delivered_id} and read confirm_token, then POST /api/reviews/{id} with {rating:5, confirm_token} and get 200.
